description: Utility helper functions for reading and formatting 'Credits' values from API responses in a frontend project. Provides functions to extract credits used from response objects and to format numerical credits values for display.

methods.name: getCreditsUsed(details)
methods.description: Safely extracts the credits used from a details response object, considering camelCase and snake_case keys and nested data, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: formatCredits(value, locale = undefined)
methods.description: Formats a numeric credits value into a locale-aware string with specified decimal precision, or returns a placeholder if input is null or invalid.
